cands.name: Chris Sells

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 90 since November 2014. Business owner who founded Sells Medical Equipment. Graduated from Vigor High School. Has chaired the House State Government Committee (2025-26) and earlier chaired the Fiscal Responsibility Committee.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Chris Sells was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no campaign statements, questionnaire answers or interviews from him on any issue, and no detail on the bills he has sponsored. We found no documented stance on data centers or development, no reported controversies, no foreign ties, and no endorsements. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026.

qual.why: More than a decade of prior legislative service in the same chamber, plus business ownership, puts him in the high band; committee seats and chairs were not counted toward the score.
